## Why she is 'X': anonymity in reproductive cases

The petitioner appears in the record only as X. That is not a technicality: a woman asking a court about her own pregnancy should not have to trade privacy for rights.

The law points the same way. Since 2021, Section 5A of the MTP Act has made it a crime, punishable with up to a year in prison, for a doctor to reveal the name or details of a woman whose pregnancy was terminated, except to someone authorised by law [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. In the same 2022 judgment, the court said a doctor who ends a minor's pregnancy, and must report it to police under POCSO, need not disclose the girl's identity in that report if she and her guardian ask [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Even the 2009 case the bench relied on is named after an appellant; the court withheld the name of the woman at its centre [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

So do not try to identify women who go to court for an abortion, or pass on a name you see. If you need an abortion, go early to a registered doctor or a government hospital: abortion is safe when a trained provider uses a recommended method suited to the stage of pregnancy [[who-abortion]]. X won single women the same access as wives. The letter in her case name says they are owed the same privacy too.
x-v-principal-secretary-2022-case-histor.hg:
Law reports mein uska koi naam nahi hai, sirf ek letter hai. July 2022 mein X, jo unmarried thi aur lagbhag 22 hafte pregnant thi, ne Delhi High Court se pregnancy khatam karne ki ijaazat maangi, aur use mana kar diya gaya. Ek hafte ke andar Supreme Court ne uske liye raasta nikaala; aur 29 September 2022 ko usi court ne uski appeal ke zariye badal diya ki India ke abortion rules kis-kis ke liye likhe gaye hain. Ye hamare Abortion desk ke explainers ke peeche ki case history hai: court ne autonomy bachane ke liye law ko kaise padha, kahan ruk gaya, aur woh aurat anonymous kyun rahi. Ye general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## July 2022: 22 hafte pregnant, aur court se khaali haath

Uski problem ek list thi. 2021 ke amendment ke baad se 20 se 24 hafte ke beech abortion sirf unhi categories ki auraton ke liye allowed hai jinka naam rules mein likha hai, aur woh bhi tab jab do registered doctors sehmat hon [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. 12 October 2021 ko notify hue Rule 3B mein aisi saat categories thi, jinme rape survivors, minors, aur woh auratein shaamil thi jinka marital status pregnancy ke dauraan widowhood ya divorce se badal jaaye [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]]. Jis aurat ki kabhi shaadi hi nahi hui, uska is list mein koi naam nahi tha.

Is list ki apni history thi. 1971 ke Act ne maana tha ki contraceptive fail hone par aurat ki mental health ko gehri chot pahunchti hai, lekin sirf tab jab use "any married woman or her husband", yaani kisi shaadishuda aurat ya uske pati, ne use kiya ho [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]]. Ye shabd 2021 mein jaakar "any woman or her partner" bane [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Lekin aage ki pregnancy ke rules ab bhi auraton ko shaadi ke hisaab se baant rahe the.

15 July 2022 ko Delhi High Court ne use interim relief dene se mana kar diya, aur kaha ki woh "cannot go beyond the Statute", yaani law ke shabdon se aage nahi ja sakta [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Ye literal tareeka hai: jo likha hai wahi lagao, aur jo log list se chhoot gaye, unhe Parliament ka intezaar karne do. Lekin jis aurat ki pregnancy har din aage badh rahi ho, uske liye intezaar ka matlab hi 'na' hai.

## 21 July 2022: interim order aur AIIMS ka board

Usne appeal ki. 21 July 2022 ko Supreme Court ne High Court ka order badla aur use pregnancy khatam karne ki ijaazat di, is shart par ki AIIMS Delhi ka Medical Board ise safe maane [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Baad mein AIIMS ne report kiya ki termination safely ho gaya [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

Isse uska apna case toh sulajh gaya. Lekin legal sawaal wahin khada tha: kya kisi aurat ko 20 se 24 hafte ke beech sirf isliye care se mana kiya ja sakta hai kyunki uski kabhi shaadi nahi hui? Final judgment ne iska jawab India ki har unmarried aurat ke liye diya.

## 29 September 2022: autonomy, dignity aur 'artificial' fark

Justices D.Y. Chandrachud, A.S. Bopanna aur J.B. Pardiwala ki bench ne do purane faislon ko apni neenv banaya [[sc-x-principal-secretary-2022]]. Suchita Srivastava v. Chandigarh Administration (2009) mein court ne saaf taur par aurat ki reproductive autonomy maani thi, yaani bachcha paida karne ya na karne ka faisla khud lene ka haq. K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India (2017), nau judges ke privacy wale faisle, mein court ne abortion ke kaanooni haq ko Article 21 ke under reproductive choices ke haq se joda tha [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

Reasoning do steps mein chali. Agar Rule 3B ko sirf shaadishuda auraton ke liye padha jaaye, toh woh unmarried auraton ke saath bhedbhaav karega aur Article 14, yaani barabari ke haq, ko todega [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Isliye use aise nahi padha ja sakta: unmarried aur single auraton ko 20 se 24 hafte ke beech abortion ka utna hi haq hai jitna shaadishuda auraton ko [[sc-x-principal-secretary-2022]].

> "This artificial distinction between married and single women is not constitutionally sustainable." Yaani shaadishuda aur single auraton ke beech ka ye banawati fark Constitution ki kasauti par tik nahi sakta. [[sc-x-principal-secretary-2022]]

Court ne rule ko radd nahi kiya. Usne "change of marital status" wali category ko aise padha ki usme woh unmarried aur single auratein bhi aa jaayein jinke halaat pregnancy ke dauraan badal jaate hain [[sc-x-principal-secretary-2022]]. Constitution ko saamne rakhkar kisi rule ko uske maqsad ke hisaab se padhna "cannot go beyond the Statute" ka bilkul ulta hai. Is case mein jeet aur haar ka fark yahi tha.

## Marital rape maana gaya, par sirf ek law ke liye

Judgment ne ek doosra sawaal bhi suljhaaya. Rule 3B ki pehli category sexual assault ya rape ki survivors ki hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-rules-2021]]. Bench ne kaha ki wahan "rape" mein pati ka apni patni ke saath kiya rape bhi shaamil hai, "solely for the purposes of the MTP Act", yaani sirf MTP Act ke maqsad ke liye. Isliye jo patni zabardasti ke sex se pregnant hui hai, woh 24 hafte tak abortion maang sakti hai [[sc-x-principal-secretary-2022]]. Iske liye use pehle FIR karne ya court mein rape saabit karne ki zaroorat nahi [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

Sirf isi law ke liye kyun? Kyunki Indian Penal Code ke marital rape exception ko di gayi chunauti ek alag bench ke saamne pending thi [[sc-x-principal-secretary-2022]]. 11 May 2022 ko Delhi High Court ke do judges is exception par alag-alag raay de chuke the, aur woh case Supreme Court pahunch gaya tha [[livelaw-rit-foundation-split-2022]].

Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ke Section 63 ka Exception 2 aaj bhi kehta hai ki agar patni 18 ya usse zyada umar ki hai, toh pati ka uske saath sex rape nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 19 November 2026 tak Supreme Court ne faisla nahi diya tha, aur kaha tha ki final hearing 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko rakhi jaayegi [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]]. Tab tak adult patni ke saath pati ki zabardasti abortion ke liye rape maani jaati hai, lekin rape ke crime ke roop mein nahi.

## Woh 'X' kyun hai: reproductive cases mein anonymity

Record mein petitioner sirf X ke naam se darj hai. Ye koi technicality nahi hai: apni hi pregnancy ke baare mein court jaane wali aurat ko apne haq ke badle apni privacy nahi chukaani chahiye.

Law bhi isi taraf ishaara karta hai. 2021 se MTP Act ka Section 5A kisi bhi doctor ke liye ye crime banata hai ki woh abortion karwane wali aurat ka naam ya details kisi ko bataye, siwaay us insaan ke jise law ne authorise kiya ho; iski saza ek saal tak ki jail hai [[gazette-mtp-amendment-act-2021]]. Usi 2022 ke judgment mein court ne kaha ki jo doctor kisi minor ki pregnancy khatam karta hai, aur jise POCSO ke under police ko report karna padta hai, use us report mein ladki ki pehchaan batane ki zaroorat nahi, agar ladki aur uske guardian aisa kahein [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]]. Yahan tak ki 2009 ka jo case bench ne aadhaar banaya, woh bhi ek appellant ke naam par hai; court ne us case ke kendra mein khadi aurat ka naam chhupa kar rakha tha [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

Isliye abortion ke liye court jaane wali auraton ki pehchaan dhoondhne ki koshish mat kijiye, aur kahin naam dikhe toh use aage mat badhaiye. Agar aapko abortion chahiye, toh jaldi kisi registered doctor ya sarkari hospital jaiye: jab trained provider pregnancy ke stage ke hisaab se recommended tareeka use karta hai, toh abortion safe hota hai [[who-abortion]]. X ki wajah se single auraton ko shaadishuda auraton jaisa access mila. Uske case ke naam ka woh ek letter yaad dilaata hai ki unhe utni hi privacy ka haq bhi hai.
